title: FRR / EVPN fabric
description: frr_exporter on the VyOS leaves and DHCP VMs: BGP, BFD, EVPN and routes.

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: BGP sessions reported by frr_exporter (underlay IPv6 unicast, EVPN to the spines, external peerings). A router whose exporter is down drops out of the total.

panels.title: Flaps in range
panels.description: Session restarts in the selected time range (drops in the session uptime).

panels.title: Youngest BGP session
panels.description: Lowest session uptime; orange if a session came up within the last hour.

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)

panels.title: Exporter problems
panels.description: frr_exporter targets that don't answer and collectors that failed.

panels.title: BGP peers
panels.description: One row per session. Underlay sessions use interface peers (eth1/eth2, BGP unnumbered); EVPN sessions go to the spines' loopbacks. peer_hostname is only filled in where FRR learns it from the peer (external sessions).

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)

panels.title: BGP session state
panels.description: Gaps mean the router's exporter wasn't scraped.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, local_as, peer_as, peer_hostname) (frr_bgp_peer_state{host=~"$host"})

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)
No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)

targets.expr: sum by (host, vrf, afi, safi, peer) (resets(frr_bgp_peer_uptime_seconds{host=~"$host"}[$__range])) > 0

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)
No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)
No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)

panels.title: BFD peers
panels.description: Link-local peers are the underlay links to the spines; fd69:255:240::1/::2 are the spine loopbacks (EVPN).

defaults.noValue: No BFD peers on the selected router(s)

panels.title: BFD peers up per router
panels.description: Up / configured BFD peers. Routers without BFD peers (DHCP VMs) are left out.

defaults.noValue: No BFD peers on the selected router(s)
No BFD peers on the selected router(s)

panels.title: Remote VTEPs per router
panels.description: Remote VTEPs of the router's busiest L2 VNI.

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

panels.title: EVPN MACs per router
panels.description: MAC entries over all L2 VNIs (local and remote).

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

panels.title: EVPN ARP/ND entries per router
panels.description: ARP/ND (MAC+IP) entries over all L2 VNIs.

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

panels.title: Remote VTEPs per L2 VNI
panels.description: Columns are tenant VRF / VNI. A 0 means no other leaf has this VNI.

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, vxlanIf) (label_join(label_replace(frr_bgp_l2vpn_evpn_remote_vtep_count_total{type="L2", host=~"$host"}, "t", "$1", "tenantVrf", "(?:lylat_)?(.*)"), "segment", "/", "t", "vni"))

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, vxlanIf) (label_join(label_replace(frr_bgp_l2vpn_evpn_mac_count_total{type="L2", host=~"$host"}, "t", "$1", "tenantVrf", "(?:lylat_)?(.*)"), "segment", "/", "t", "vni"))

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

targets.expr: max without (instance, job, role, vxlanIf) (label_join(label_replace(frr_bgp_l2vpn_evpn_arp_nd_count_total{type="L2", host=~"$host"}, "t", "$1", "tenantVrf", "(?:lylat_)?(.*)"), "segment", "/", "t", "vni"))

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

panels.title: EVPN MACs and ARP/ND per tenant VRF
panels.description: Largest count on any router (each leaf sees the whole EVPN table).

defaults.noValue: No L2 VNIs on the selected router(s)

panels.title: Routes per VRF
panels.description: Zebra RIB routes per VRF and address family.

panels.title: Routes per VRF (largest on any router)
RIB routes not in the FIB
panels.description: Zebra routes that aren't installed in the kernel (normally 0).

targets.expr: sum by (host) (frr_route_total{host=~"$host", vrf=~"$vrf"}) - sum by (host) (frr_route_total_fib{host=~"$host", vrf=~"$vrf"})

defaults.noValue: No BGP sessions on the selected router(s)
